about_the_game:
Experience the ultimate 2D ghost hunting – the Hunter Corporation needs you!

You are a new recruit of the mysterious Hunter Corporation – an organization that hunts ghosts by collecting and analyzing artifacts. Your missions take you to abandoned houses, dark forests, and decaying locations. Collect artifacts, analyze them, and uncover the identities of the spirits, all while finding yourself in dangerous situations that will fill you with fear and suspense.

Features:

  • Exciting 2D Top-Down Gameplay: Explore locations full of artifacts and hidden dangers.

  • Dynamic Ghost Events: No two games are alike – ghosts react to your actions and have their own unique behaviors.

  • Risk-Reward System: The riskier the mission, the greater the reward – or the danger.

  • Collect and Analyze Artifacts: Investigate anomalies to identify ghosts and successfully complete missions.

  • Strategic Equipment: Purchase items that help you detect the most dangerous ghosts more effectively.

Dive into a world full of secrets, suspense, and unpredictable spirits – every mission could be your last. Add ‘What Is The Ghost’ to your wishlist and face the challenge!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 (4. Gen) or AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrierte Intel HD Graphics 4000 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 (6. Gen) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 Ti or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Ghosts haunt the living, and only your company can identify them. Search haunted apartments, collect suspicious artifacts, and reveal cursed objects. But beware: the longer you stay, the stronger the ghost’s presence grows - and the deadlier your investigation becomes.
